name: codex-bridge
tagline: Image generation and GPT-5 subagents for Claude Code via Codex CLI — no OpenAI API key
description: codex-bridge is a Claude Code plugin that adds image generation (gpt-image-2) and GPT-5 subagents through the Codex CLI login you already have, with no OpenAI API key required. Claude scopes and verifies the work while Codex handles the volume. It ships five subagents — artist, reviewer, debugger, implementer, and second-opinion — plus skills for generate-image, edit-image, codex-review, and codex-delegate.
highlights: Image generation with gpt-image-2 through the Codex CLI login
GPT-5 subagents with no OpenAI API key — uses your ChatGPT plan
Five subagents: artist, reviewer, debugger, implementer, second-opinion
Skills for generate-image, edit-image, codex-review, and codex-delegate
Claude orchestrates and verifies; Codex does the volume
curatorNote: Bridging Claude Code to Codex through the ChatGPT plan is a clever way to cut token costs and unlock image generation without a second API key. The division of labor — Claude scopes, Codex executes — is a pattern worth copying.
